sources.title: The Viṣṇu Purāṇa, Book 4, chapters 13–17: Yadu, Vṛṣṇi, Kṛṣṇa, Turvasu and Druhyu lines
sources.edition: McComas Taylor, trans., The Viṣṇu Purāṇa: Ancient Annals of the God with Lotus Eyes (ANU Press, 2021), Book 4, chapters 13–17; locators follow the verse numbering printed in the ANU translation.
sources.note: Claims cover only Book 4, chapters 13–17; no chapter 12 material is included. Chapter 13/14 repeated names (including Bhajamāna, Vṛṣṇi and Śini) are kept context-specific where the text does not unambiguously establish identity. The 4.14–15 rebirth chain is represented as distinct person nodes connected by explicit rebirth claims. Divine Vāsudeva born as Kṛṣṇa is distinct from the human father Vasudeva/Ānakadundubhi. Chapter 13 begins with Sātvata’s descendants, but these chapters do not restate his connection to Yadu.
